decisions.reason: The source explicitly changes only Big Block prize parameters; the independent Small Block prize amount, winner count, eligibility, and trigger remain unchanged.
Changing the Big Block prize amount and draw condition does not change ticket-counter independence, eligibility windows, post-draw resets, or ticket weighting.
The source does not change the referral commission or the award of one Small Block and one Big Block ticket per successful coded referral.
The Big Block parameter change does not state that secondary-sale royalties cease funding prize pools or otherwise alter the pool-funding rule.
The source retains five winners and does not change random selection, winner eligibility, or ticket-weighted winning chances.
The source changes Big Block amount and draw parameters but does not alter the manual prize-claim workflow.
The Big Block mechanism remains active, so its metadata ticket counter remains valid and the source does not request any metadata change.
The source does not change whether royalties are required or enforced on secondary sales.
The source does not alter the no-referral mint trigger, random ticket award, or eligible recipient population.
The Big Block prize parameter change is unrelated to the first-referral badge condition.
